name: cnsplots
summary: Publication-quality scientific figures in Python via the cnsplots package, including the rcParams style contract, grid/multi-panel composition patterns, dense journal-figure techniques, cross-panel color strategy, and Cell/Nature/Science figure specifications.

verification.method: mamba env (cnsplots 0.8.0) upgraded in place from 0.7.0 and re-verified end to end. Re-measured all 78 cns.settings values and the 33-key rcParams diff and confirmed both are byte-identical to 0.7.0, so the palette_seq=gnuplot and Helvetica-first font_sans_serif findings and their viridis/Arial overrides still stand. Diffed the upstream agent skill between tags v0.7.0 and v0.8.0 (+51/-13 lines) and confirmed the release is a units-and-export change: figure()/multipanel()/panel() gained keyword-only unit= and dimensions are now documented as points, figure() now returns the Figure instead of None, savefig() gained fig=/dpi=/transparent=/bbox_inches=/pad_inches=, settings.context() now wraps matplotlib.rc_context and restores rcParams, and mp.newline() was reimplemented from a width-consuming spacer to a true row break. Ran all six bundled scripts and all six bundled templates on 0.8.0 with zero failures. Measured the canvas-versus-saved-size gap that motivates the new export controls: a 519-point (183.1 mm) multipanel canvas holding one 240x150 panel saves at 94.4 mm under the default bbox_inches='tight' and at 183.1 mm with bbox_inches=None, and verified the emitted journal preset now produces an exact 183.0 mm-wide page at max_width=183, unit='mm'. Confirmed newline() now breaks one row on a single call where 0.7.0 did not, and re-pinned the composition-patterns source citations to _multipanels.py lines 460/420/504. Verified the new public surface exists and behaves as documented: precisionrecallplot, calibrationplot, get_comparison_results (6 rows, 13 columns on tips x day pairs='all'), get_survival_results (DataFrame), get_roc_results/get_precision_recall_results/get_calibration_results, available_palettes (28 qualitative + 5 continuous), register_palette, and get_palette_colors. Corrected two claims that were already wrong before this release: the Ecotyper1 membership of the named constants, and the assertion that diverging colormap names are usable as color_cycle. Fixed dump_style.py to enumerate palettes through available_palettes(), which recovered six names it had been silently omitting.
verification.notes: Figure density and all journal conversions are unchanged from 1.7.0 because the numeric geometry is unchanged; 0.8.0 renames the unit from pixels to points without altering the inch conversion. The vendored upstream showcase is byte-identical between v0.7.0 and v0.8.0, so templates/upstream-showcase/ needed only a version stamp. mutool is still absent, so SVG export falls back to plain matplotlib SVG with a RuntimeWarning; unrelated to skill correctness.
